name: Bhaskarabhatta
dates_notes: Placed around the turn of the tenth century on the basis of the textual and cataloguing tradition for the *Śivasūtravārttika*.
core_thesis: Bhāskarabhaṭṭa is the early Kashmirian commentator credited with the *Śivasūtravārttika*, an independent extended exegesis of the *Śiva-sūtras*. The work belongs to the formative reception of the sūtras before the later summaries of Kṣemarāja. Its roster value is textual and philosophical: it preserves an early interpretive line for the Śiva-sūtra doctrine rather than merely repeating the better-known Kṣemarāja tradition. Fine-grained doctrinal claims should await a verified text witness.

engaged_works.title: Sivasutra-varttika
engaged_works.ascription_notes: Catalogued and edited as Bhāskarabhaṭṭa's commentary on the *Śiva-sūtras*.
engaged_works.summary: An extended Sanskrit commentary on the *Śiva-sūtras*. It is a significant witness to early Kashmir Śaiva interpretation of the sūtra corpus; a Kashmir Series edition is known, but no verified local text has been linked to this entry.
